proposalScope: Replacing actual SendUsersAsync per-connection live user-ID membership with a once-per-send Ordinal snapshot/index of caller-owned IReadOnlyList input.
conclusion: IReadOnlyList, IsReadOnly, reference identity and count do not establish immutable user-target input or a substitutable Ordinal comparer. The recommended simple per-send snapshot is not selected. This is design-blocked rejection, not comparative no-gain, not a bug fix, and not proof that all alternative optimizations are impossible.
